text:
maya: thinking about the rollout UX for automatic fallback policies — we need clearer degrade modes and an audit trail. who wants to weigh in?
kevin: +1. current UI only shows "on/off" with a single fallback model. we should expose triggers and a severity level.
alex: triggers we should support: p99 latency > X, error-rate > Y, model OOM, kv-cache miss spike, and explicit healthcheck failures. quick list as modes: "graceful-degrade" (return partial result + warning), "fallback-model" (route to cheaper model), "reject-with-retry" (429 + retry-after), "queue" (shed to background), "circuit-open" (block).
sara: audit requirements: every automatic switch must record: trigger metrics snapshot, which routing decision executed, previous model/version, user-facing behavior, and a trace id to tie to request logs. ops-bot: incident note created when circuit-open persists > 5m with tag: auto-fallback.
dmitri: UX suggestion — in the Console rollout page show a timeline bar with colored segments (normal, degraded-soft, fallback, blocked). hover shows the trigger and snapshot. also allow filters: by route, by customer, by model.
maya: +1 on timeline. also need a compact config editor for infra teams: default policy + per-route overrides. propose a small policy DSL in YAML so it's readable. example:```yamlpolicy:
  default:
    triggers:
      - type: latency_p99
        threshold_ms: 1200
      - type: error_rate
        threshold_pct: 5
    actions:
      - type: fallback_model
        model: redwood-medium
        cooldown: 300s
      - type: audit_log
        severity: low
  routes:
    /chat/standard:
      overrides:
        - trigger: latency_p99
          threshold_ms: 800
          actions:
            - type: graceful-degrade
              message: "partial result: summarizing"
```
kevin: love the DSL. question: do we let the action sequence be conditional? e.g., try fallback-model, if that fails escalate to reject-with-retry.
alex: yes, sequence + failure-policy. add `on_action_failure: next` or `escalate_to`.
sara: on the Console side we need a compact human-readable audit entry for each auto event: short summary, metrics (latency, err rate), decision taken, links to full trace. allow quick rollback of a policy from that entry.
dmitri: ops question — who can mutate these policies? RBAC: engineers for their routes, infra for global defaults, SRE for emergency overrides. UI should show last-modifier and a diff when applying a change.
maya: also need a telemetry plan: emit events named `auto_fallback.triggered`, `auto_fallback.action_executed`, `auto_fallback.recovered`. include fields: route, model_before, model_after, trigger_type, metric_snapshot, trace_id, policy_id. make them queryable in Console analytics.
kevin: implementational caveat: metric snapshots must be taken atomically close to decision time. i.e., capture p50/p90/p99 and error counts in the same window.
opl: ops-bot: reminder: we already have infra metrics ingestion for all models — we can reuse the same windowing. will add new event names.
sara: small UX nit: when a policy is in cooldown, show a dismissible banner in the Console with link to the audit entry. users should be able to acknowledge.
dmitri: can we add a feature flag to rollout this UI for a small set of customers first? want to test confusion/false positives.
maya: yes, feature flag + telemetry on `ui_acknowledge` and `manual_override`. We'll draft a short spec and a mockup for Monday. volunteers?
alex: I can mock the timeline component.
kevin: I’ll prototype the DSL parsing and the action-sequence semantics.
sara: I’ll own Console audit entries + acknowledge flow.
dmitri: I’ll write RBAC matrix and rollout plan.
maya: thanks — assigning owners. quick follow-ups: add an explicit `audit-only` mode (log triggers but don't change routing) for safe tuning, and an `explain` feature that surfaces WHY a fallback was chosen (metric comparator + the policy rule).
alex: `explain` should return the exact rule id + evaluated values. nice for debugging.
maya: cool. saving notes here. will post the spec doc link when ready. :thumbsup:
